scenes.title: What is Photosynthesis
scenes.narration: Have you ever wondered how plants get their food? Unlike us, plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide in a amazing process called photosynthesis.
scenes.imagePrompt: A green plant under a bright warm sun with water drops on its roots

scenes.title: Inside the Leaf
scenes.narration: This magic happens right inside the leaves. Tiny parts called chloroplasts hold a green pigment named chlorophyll, which catches the sunlight.
scenes.imagePrompt: A close up cartoon of a green leaf showing tiny green circles inside

scenes.title: The Word Equation
scenes.narration: We can write this down as an equation. Carbon dioxide plus water, using sunlight, turns into glucose for food, and releases oxygen into the air.
scenes.imagePrompt: A simple equation diagram with plant ingredients on one side and food and oxygen on the other

scenes.title: Why It Matters
scenes.narration: This is super important for all of us. Photosynthesis feeds almost all life on Earth and gives us the fresh oxygen we breathe every day.
scenes.imagePrompt: Earth surrounded by green leaves and smiling people breathing fresh air
